checks.name: mouse 1: enter the studio at the desk station
mouse 2: dragging looks around the room (yaw/pitch change, no navigation)
mouse 2b: looking around is limited to the room (no free flight)
mouse 3a: hovering the computer names it
mouse 3: selecting the computer moves the camera to its screen (/#computer) with a readable menu
mouse 4: back in the room at the same viewpoint the visitor left
mouse 5a: hovering the organizer names it
mouse 5: selecting the floppy organizer moves to it (/#disks)
mouse 6a: hovering a disk names its case ID and project
mouse 6: the existing 3D disk is lifted out of the organizer and held in front of the camera (/#disk/zarvin-one)
mouse 7: inserted physically and the project is readable on the CRT (registry text, case ID)
mouse 8: Escape returns to the room at the previous viewpoint; the disk stays in the drive
Back returns to the computer station with the disk still loaded
Forward returns to the desk at the same viewpoint
ASK.EXE runs on the physical CRT (existing navigator; deterministic answer, no network)
CONTACT.TXT runs on the physical CRT with the real links
Read case study opens the expanded interface for long content
Return from the case study lands back on the held disk (state preserved)
keyboard 2: Shift+arrows look around the room
keyboard 3: C selects the computer; focus moves into the CRT menu
keyboard 4: Escape returns to the room at the previous viewpoint
keyboard 5: D (or ←/→) selects the floppy organizer
keyboard 6a: the disk list opens and takes focus
keyboard 6: Enter lifts the disk to the camera (/#disk/zarvin-one)
keyboard 7: Insert into drive -> project on the CRT; focus in its file list
keyboard 7b: arrow keys read the next file (STATUS.TXT)
keyboard 8: Escape returns to the room at the previous viewpoint
touch 2: dragging a finger looks around the room
touch 3: tapping the computer moves to its screen
touch 4: Back to the desk restores the viewpoint
touch 5: tapping the organizer moves to it
touch 6: tapping a disk lifts it to the camera
touch 6b: the actions are 44px touch targets
touch 7: inserted; the project is readable on the CRT
touch 8: the Desk station returns to the room at the previous viewpoint
direct link /#computer opens that station
direct link /#disks opens that station
direct link /#disk/proof-first opens that station
no uncaught page errors
